title: What If the World Ran Short of Computer Chips? 2021 Showed

scenes.text: What if the world ran short of computer chips? In 2021, it did.
Car factories slowed down, because modern cars depend on chips.
The consulting firm AlixPartners estimated that automakers would lose 210 billion dollars in revenue that year.
That was roughly 7.7 million vehicles that never got built.
The estimate kept climbing: about 60 billion in January, 110 billion in May, then 210 billion in September.
Lockdowns in Malaysia and shortages of other materials made it worse. One tiny part, and the biggest assembly lines on Earth sat short.

description:
What if the world ran short of computer chips? In 2021 it already happened.
AlixPartners estimated that the chip shortage would cost the global auto industry 210 billion dollars in revenue and about 7.7 million vehicles of lost production that year, up from 60 billion in its first estimate in January.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: How many things you own would stop working without a chip? Drop your own what if.
